contract.tax_note: USD nett, non-commissionable. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes the hotel may add them from the date of implementation.
contract.child_policy_text: The hotel maintains a policy that only individuals aged 18 years and above are eligible for accommodation. Guests under the age of 18 will not be permitted to stay at the property, and all guests aged 18 and over will be considered as adults for booking purposes.
contract.guide_policy_text: No guide / driver accommodation terms are printed in the wellness-package document (the Luxury Reserves all-market contract carries the Lagoon guide / tour-leader policy).
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellations within 07 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 14 days of the arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 21 days of the arrival date – 25% of the value of the booking. Group bookings, more than 8 rooms, will be liable to pay 50% of the basis booked before 30 days of arrival.
contract.payment_text: Travel agents without credit facilities are required to make the relevant payment 05 days before the clients check into the hotel. Travel agents that are entitled to credit facilities should make necessary payments within one month of the departure of guests. For Short notice / Last minute bookings, 100% of the payment is to be made on confirmation.

contract.notes: Transcribed from "Jetwing Lagoon Wellness, A Luxury Reserve - Wellness Packages - Winter 2026-2027.pdf" (14 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. One rate block for the whole document (01 Nov 2026 – 30 Apr 2027): Luxury Room on single / double / triple Full Board basis + Wellness Package, USD 290 / 410 / 510 per room per night (all three printed — no reduction arithmetic), plus room supplements Luxury Room with Terrace +25, Garden Suite +100, Lagoon Suite +200 per room per night. The same rate applies to every package; the package only decides the inclusions, which depend on the length of stay. Durations printed per package (nights): Shanthi Retreat - Stress Management 3/5/7/14; Balance & Bliss - A wellness welcome 1/2/3/5; Shodhani - Detoxification 5/7/10/14; Yoga Retreat: Sathi Yoga - Mindful yoga 3/5/7; Harmony Yoga - Energize with yoga 3/5/7; Revitalize Retreat 3/5/7/10/14; Sleep Retreat 3/5/7/10; Weight Retreat - Body Lightness 7/14. Each package is an offer row whose min_nights is the shortest printed duration — the rate lookup does NOT enforce it, staff check; Balance & Bliss starts at 1 night, so the plan itself carries no minimum stay. Stays of a length not printed for a package (e.g. 4 or 6 nights) are not described — confirm the inclusions with the hotel. Special offer, priority 10: customer quotations walk past special offers to the contract, so this FB package price does not replace the all-market FB room rate (rts_jwl_lagoon_wellness) in quotations; the existing Short Stay offer (#344, BB/HB + treatment, maximum 2 nights) is a separate plan. Whether the wellness package (treatments) is for every guest in the room is not stated (the double and triple rates suggest per guest). Adults only (18+). No booking window, rate code, gala dinner, contract date or guide policy is printed. Market list: "Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market" → DOM excluded. Payment terms here are the standard Jetwing ones (not the Short Stay document's 50% on confirmation).
